htt/src/common/semantic_guards/no_overclaim.py:283-314 scans each line, with multiline folding implemented only for legacy curl claims.
htt/src/common/semantic_guards/no_overclaim.py:618-627 treats any guardrail marker anywhere in the matched sentence as a negative context.
artifacts/A-PR291-R2-CLAIM/hostile_claim_oracle.py and hostile_claim_oracle.out show misses for plural, reordered modifier, multiline, and same-sentence unrelated-without variants.
